sentences.text: The documents do not state a processing fee for gold loans.
The gold-loan documents say gold loans shall be governed by the Gold Loan Operational Guidelines of the Bank, but they do not give a processing-fee amount there.
A processing fee of ₹400 appears in the Home Loan Agreement, but that document is for home loans, not gold loans.

missing.searched: Gold Loan Operational Guidelines, Gold Loan FAQ, and UCB processing-charges tables
